thread:
ana: Thinking about tightening our postmortem follow-ups — proposal below. TL;DR: short timeline template + 7-day ack + weekly remediation sync + 4-week recurring-pattern review. Thoughts?

sam: +1 to the timeline template. can we make it 3 buckets: action, owner, ETA?

jordan: 3 buckets works. also add a field for 'rollback risk' (low/med/high) so we can prioritize.

marta: Love the 7-day ack SLA idea. Right now a bunch of owners go dark after postmortem. 7 days to accept/assign would help.

ana (typo correction): ana meant me 🙃 — will volunteer to draft the template.

ana: draft coming in a sec:```
- Remediation item: short description
- Owner: @handle
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Acceptance: owner ack timestamp
- Risk: low/med/high
- Status: open/in-progress/blocked/closed
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: update incident 1965400001 action items before EOD.

sam: Can we also have a weekly 30m remediation sync? quick triage of stalled items and reallocate owners.

jordan: make it 30m max, agenda: 1) new actions (5m) 2) blocked (10m) 3) timeline slippage (10m) 4) follow ups (5m).

marta: Agree. nominate 2 rotation leads for these syncs so it's not always the same engineer.

ana: About incident commander rotation: propose 3-week window per IC with overlap week for handoff. that gives context time.

sam: Overlap week is great. who owns scheduling? ops/oncall?

jordan: Suggest oncall-manager owns rotas, but IC shift-specific signups live in a simple RFC-owned doc.

marta: On recurring incident patterns — propose a monthly "trend triage" where we pull incidents with same signatures (e.g., high-latency GC, model OOMs) and assign a short investigation spike.

ana: For tracking, I'd like a lightweight tracker spreadsheet + a pinned issue per remediation on the internal repo. link from PM to code issue.

sam: +1. Example quick rule: if an action slips by >7 days, escalate to manager and add to next weekly remediation sync agenda automatically.

oncall-bot: Action escalation created: #escalations-1965432100 (auto).

jordan: We should avoid bureaucracy. keep templates tiny and defaults auto-populated. maybe a Slack modal to create items?

marta: Modal would be slick. low-effort MVP: short Slack form + message to #remediation-tracker channel.

ana: I'll prototype the template + a one-pager for the flow (7-day ack, weekly sync, escalation) and post by Friday.

sam: Awesome. once you post, can we run a 2-week pilot on 3 active postmortems? pick one infra, one serving, one runtime.

ana: Yes. I'll pick candidates and @marta for the infra one.

marta: happy to be infra owner for pilot.

jordan: I can own the serving one.

sam: I'll handle runtime sample.

ana: Cool — pilot kickoff next Monday. agenda for kickoff: share template, owners ack, schedule weekly syncs, confirm escalation rules.

marta: tiny nit — can we add a "verify in prod" checklist when closing items that affect runtime? quick smoke tests list.

ana: added to template draft.

oncall-bot: Note: Pilot kickoff scheduled: 1966000000. Reminder will post 24h before.

sam: Great work all. quick follow-ups: when draft is up drop the link here and I'll add invites for the weekly syncs. :thumbsup:

ana: Will do. thanks!
